title.en: Marketing mix: product, branding, packaging and labelling
title.kn: ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ: ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ, ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್, ಪ್ಯಾಕೇಜಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಲೇಬಲಿಂಗ್

heading.en: The 4 Ps begin with the product

hook.en: Why do you recognise a biscuit packet from across the shop even before you read it? Branding, packaging and labelling are doing their job.
hook.kn: ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ಆಚೆಯಿಂದಲೇ ಒಂದು ಬಿಸ್ಕತ್ ಪ್ಯಾಕೆಟ್ ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ, ಓದುವ ಮೊದಲೇ. ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್, ಪ್ಯಾಕೇಜಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಲೇಬಲ್ ತಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿವೆ.

objectives.en: Name the four elements of the marketing mix
Explain levels and functions of packaging and functions of labelling

narration.en: Why do you recognise a biscuit packet from across the shop even before you read it? Branding, packaging and labelling are doing their job.
narration.kn: ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ಆಚೆಯಿಂದಲೇ ಒಂದು ಬಿಸ್ಕತ್ ಪ್ಯಾಕೆಟ್ ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ, ಓದುವ ಮೊದಲೇ. ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್, ಪ್ಯಾಕೇಜಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಲೇಬಲ್ ತಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿವೆ.

body.en: The marketing mix is the set of marketing tools a firm uses to pursue its objectives in the target market: Product, Price, Place and Promotion, the 4 Ps. A product is anything of value offered to a market to satisfy needs: a bundle of utilities. Consumer products are classified as convenience, shopping and speciality products; industrial products are bought for use in producing other goods.
body.kn: ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ: ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ, ಬೆಲೆ, ಸ್ಥಳ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತೇಜನ ಎಂಬ ನಾಲ್ಕು P ಗಳು. ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಎಂದರೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಪೂರೈಸುವ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತೆಗಳ ಕಟ್ಟು.

points.en: Convenience: bought often with little effort, e.g. bread, toothpaste
Shopping: compared before buying, e.g. clothes, TV
Speciality: special features, extra effort, e.g. designer watch

title.en: On the board: Product, brand and package

narration.en: The marketing mix is the four Ps: product, price, place and promotion.

say.en: The marketing mix is the four Ps: product, price, place and promotion.
Consumer products are convenience, shopping or speciality products.
A brand name can be spoken; a brand mark is only recognised. A trademark is a brand protected by law.

text.en: Name: spoken. Mark: seen. Trademark: legal

say.en: Packaging has three levels, one inside the other.
The label on the package describes the product, grades it, and gives the information the law requires.

body.en: Branding is giving a name, sign or symbol to a product. A brand is a name, term, sign, symbol or design used to identify the goods of one seller and distinguish them from competitors. Brand name: the part that can be spoken. Brand mark: the part that can be recognised but not spoken, such as a symbol. A trademark is a brand or part of a brand given legal protection, so no one else can use it.
body.kn: ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡಿಂಗ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರು ಅಥವಾ ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ನೀಡುವುದು. ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಭಾಗ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಹೆಸರು; ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸಲಾಗದ ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಗುರುತು; ಕಾನೂನು ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಪಡೆದದ್ದು ಟ್ರೇಡ್‌ಮಾರ್ಕ್.

points.en: Helps the marketer: differentiation, advertising, premium price, new launches
Helps the customer: identification, quality assurance, status

narration.en: Branding is giving a name, sign or symbol to a product. A brand is a name, term, sign, symbol or design used to identify the goods of one seller and distinguish them from competitors. Brand name: the part that can be spoken. Brand mark: the part that can be recognised but not spoken, such as a symbol. A trademark is a brand or part of a brand given legal protection, so no one else can use it.
narration.kn: ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡಿಂಗ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರು ಅಥವಾ ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ನೀಡುವುದು. ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಭಾಗ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಹೆಸರು; ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸಲಾಗದ ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಗುರುತು; ಕಾನೂನು ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಪಡೆದದ್ದು ಟ್ರೇಡ್‌ಮಾರ್ಕ್.

body.en: Packaging is designing and producing the container or wrapper. Levels: primary package (the immediate container, e.g. the toothpaste tube), secondary package (additional layer, e.g. the cardboard box), and transportation packaging (for storage and transport). Functions: product identification, protection, convenience of use and promotion. A label is the part of the package carrying information. Functions of labelling: describe the product and its contents, identify the product or brand, grade the product, help in promotion, and give information required by law.
body.kn: ಪ್ಯಾಕೇಜಿಂಗ್‌ನ ಮೂರು ಹಂತಗಳು: ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ, ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಗಣೆ ಪ್ಯಾಕೇಜಿಂಗ್. ಲೇಬಲ್ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ದರ್ಜೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾನೂನು ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Secondary: extra protective layer, thrown away before use

problem.en: A shampoo comes in a plastic bottle, which is packed in a printed cardboard carton; 48 cartons travel in a corrugated box to the shop. Identify the three levels of packaging.

steps.en: The plastic bottle holds the shampoo directly: primary package.
The carton is an extra layer removed before use: secondary package.
The corrugated box is used only for storage and shipping: transportation packaging.

answer.en: Bottle: primary; carton: secondary; corrugated box: transportation packaging.
